data.title: mTOR: from growth signal integration to cancer, diabetes and ageing
data.authors: Zoncu R; Sabatini DM et al.

evidence.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Authoritative review of mTOR from growth-signal integration to disease.
data.abstract_excerpt: In all eukaryotes, the target of rapamycin (TOR) signalling pathway couples energy and nutrient abundance to the execution of cell growth and division, owing to the ability of TOR protein kinase to simultaneously sense energy, nutrients and stress and, in metazoans, growth factors. Mammalian TOR complex 1 (mTORC1) and mTORC2 exert their actions by regulating other important kinases, such as S6 kinase (S6K) and Akt.
